source.title: extra-eyes raw watcher execution cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding raw watcher execution. Result: 15 unit tests passed and 18 integration tests passed. Coverage includes raw profile command spawning with exact cwd/env, versioned JSON stdin envelope containing watcher/tick_id/prompt/context, JSONL stdout message parsing into queued messages, malformed/unsupported stdout status records, nonzero-exit isolation, daemon liveness after watcher failure, subsequent sibling watcher execution, timeout kill/reap, and cost cap behavior for cap=0 skip and reported usage exceeding cap.
